title: 30A Linger Longer | 4BR Rental on 30A | Royal Destinations
meta_description: 30A Linger Longer is a Spanish villa-style 4BR Gulf front home in gated Vizcaya. Enjoy panoramic views and private beach access in Dune Allen. Reserve today!
description_expanded: Description: 30A Linger Longer by Royal Destinations Location: Dune Allen Beach-Gulf Front Address: 5055 W County Highway 30A 1025, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459 Description: Welcome to 30A Linger Longer, a magnificent Gulf-front home located in the private, gated beach front community of Vizcaya in Dune Allen Beach. Vizcaya is monitored by security so that only Vizcaya residents are allowed on the private 1000+ foot wide beach. This beautiful home is situated along south Scenic Highway 30A, the ideal location for your next beach getaway! Relax, unwind, and discover all the area has to offer in true comfort. This Spanish villa-style home with four bedrooms and four baths accommodates up to ten guests. Beautifully furnished and fully appointed, the home beckons you into the expansive space to experience the ultimate escape. Hardwood floors, high beamed ceilings, and impeccable finishes all enhance the design. Living and dining areas are spacious, bright, and open with expansive floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing outstanding Gulf-front panoramic views. The chef’s kitchen features upgraded appliances, plenty of cabinetry, and a large walk-in pantry. Generous, comfortable bedrooms welcome you in after a day of sun. Gather together for sunsets in the evening on one of the many beautifully designed balconies extending the length of the home. This is a destination like no other and the ideal place to make memories to last a lifetime. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Beach Access: Gulf Front Home, Private with Security Patrol -Parking Spaces: 2 (Max) -Dining Accommodations: 10 -Panoramic Gulf Views -Community Pool Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 10 4 Bedrooms / 4 Full Baths First Floor: -Guest Room 1: King Bed with Private Bath, Private Access Porch, Stunning Gulf Views -Guest Room 2: King Bed with Private Bath -Guest Room 3: King Bed with Detached Bath -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Guest Room 4: King Bed with Detached Bath, Balcony -Queen Sleeper Sofa -Kitchen / Living / Dining /Balcony/Panoramic Views Amenities Included: -4 Adult Bikes -Beach Towel Service Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
